steps.action: Block the malicious IP at all perimeter controls — firewall, proxy, and endpoint EDR.
Review all traffic (inbound + outbound) to/from this IP across the entire log window — not just the triggering event.
Check if any internal host initiated the connection (outbound) — this may indicate C2 beaconing from a compromised endpoint.
If outbound C2 traffic is confirmed: isolate the source host immediately.
Re-image the affected host. Rotate all credentials that were accessible from it.
Subscribe firewall to an automated threat-intel feed (e.g. Spamhaus, AlienVault OTX) for continuous IP blocklist updates.
Document the malicious IP, threat intel sources, affected hosts, and all containment actions.
